Join us for this special Monday Night Full Moon Yoga @ The Museum Of Modern Renaissance Somerville MA!

About this Event

Back by popular demand: Full Moon Halloween Yoga—costumes optional!
🌕 Join us for a special Monday night Hunter’s Moon Yoga & Soundscape inside the breathtaking Museum of Modern Renaissance!
Monday, October 26, 2026 • 7:00 PM
Museum of Modern Renaissance • Somerville, MA
Spiritually, the Hunter’s Moon represents preparation, reflection, and the continuation of time as one season gives way to the next. It invites us to pause and take an honest look at where we are—our work, relationships, goals, and personal growth—and decide where we want to place our energy moving forward.
Together, we’ll move, breathe, and reconnect as a community while setting intentions for the season ahead.
This special all-levels experience includes:
✨ 60-minute guided yoga flow
🔔 15-minute restorative soundscape in Savasana
🎵 Crystal singing bowls, percussion, and a fun Halloween-inspired playlist
🌕 Hunter’s Moon reflection and intention setting
🎃 Costumes are completely optional
🎨 A truly unforgettable setting surrounded by the museum’s inspiring artwork
Whether you’re brand new to yoga or have been practicing for years, this laid-back class is open to all levels and all bodies. Come exactly as you are—or come dressed as somebody else for Halloween!
You can also DM @BulldogFlowBoston to pay directly through Venmo or Zelle.
Please arrive 10–15 minutes early to settle into the space. Phones are discouraged during class except for emergencies.
More information: bulldogflowboston.com
Cancellations are accepted seven or more days before the event.
Grab your favorite ghouls and guys, and let’s flow, have some fun, and prepare for the season ahead beneath the light of the Hunter’s Moon!

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Somerville, Workshops in Somerville.
